n = int(input())
target = input()

parentStart = []
parentEnd = []

    if target[i] == '(':
        parentStart.append(i)
    if target[i] == ')':
        parentEnd.append(i)

count = 0
for i in range(len(parentEnd)):
    s = target[parentStart[i]+1:parentEnd[i]]
    ss = s.split('_')
    for f in ss:
        if f != "":
            count += 1

Max = 0
parentEnd.insert(0, 0)
parentStart.append(len(target))

i = 1 if target[0] == '(' else 0

for idx in range(i, len(parentEnd)):
    if target[parentEnd[idx]] == ')':
        s = target[parentEnd[idx]+1:parentStart[idx]]
    else:
        s = target[parentEnd[idx]:parentStart[idx]]
    ss = s.split('_')
    for sss in ss:
        if len(sss) > Max and '(' not in sss and ')' not in sss:
            Max = len(sss)

print(f"{Max} {count}")
